Job Description 
 The Role 
 This role within the Global Propulsion Engineering division offers the opportunity to work in a highly collaborative team focused on virtual process development and execution. Propulsion related thermal and fluid simulations are the primary focus. 3D Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) models are used to directly impact design and eliminate hardware testing. Simulations are primarily focused on engines, transmissions, electric motors & drive units, with extended scope of the team in battery cells and related processes.

 What You’ll Do:
 
 Development of new and innovative CFD simulations related to electrified propulsion components
 Collaboratively work in small teams focused on the development of complex multiphase flow and/or thermal simulations
 Application of developed and developing capabilities to directly impact design, processes, and for the elimination of hardware testing
 Provide component-level and/or system-level design recommendations to Design Responsible Engineers based on interpretation of analysis results
 Participate in product design and development teams and present analysis results to engineering peers and management
 Provide technical insight for problem resolution by leveraging analysis results
 Benchmarking and evaluation of new procedures, technology, or software tools
 Contribute to the development of automation tools using Python or Java

 Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications) 
 Bachelor of Science in Engineering
 2+ years of experience with simulation, design, testing, or release of propulsion related systems
 2+ years of experience with CFD analysis of propulsion related systems
 Familiarity or practical experience with the principles of vehicle propulsion system design, operation, or testing

 What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)
 
 MS in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering with coursework in heat transfer and fluid mechanics preferred
 Experience with STAR-CCM+ or Simerics-MP+ CFD software
 Experience with CFD optimization tools
 Experience with test to model correlation
 Experience with programming in Python, Java, or equivalent languages
 Linux experience in distributed computing environments
 Experience with the latest CFD visualization techniques
 Knowledge of Siemens NX CAD modeling
 

 
 Location: Hybrid. This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to the - Global HQ Warren MI three times per week, at minimum [or other frequency dictated by the business] 
  
 Relocation: This role may be eligible for relocation benefits. 







 About GM 
 Our vision is a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions and Zero Congestion and we embrace the responsibility to lead the change that will make our world better, safer and more equitable for all.
